recaps.1: Week 1. HitMob Ent. led the week at 150.0, which is the kind of number that wins arguments in the group chat. The benching of the week: Rodger Goodell Jr. started Courtland Sutton for 3.0 and sat Jalen Coker for 33.0 — a decision that will not appear in anyone's coaching portfolio. anthone's Astounding Team beat Daevion's Daring Team by 52.0 (143.0–91.0). It was over by the early window. Tip of the cap: Fresh Prince of Bel-Air  started 137.0 of a possible 150.0 (91.3%).
